title: Saudi-Style Fennel Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish from Saudi Arabia, made with fennel and pilaf, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced fennel and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until softened and lightly browned.
Add the pilaf to the saucepan and stir to combine with the fennel.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the pilaf is lightly toasted.
